```{python}
#| label: fig-corner-sensitivity-schematic
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 2.6
#| fig-cap: "The three-terminal capacitance network has the same connections in every selection. Only the coefficient datasets change."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=14)
    elm.Capacitor().at((0, 0)).to((5, 0)).label(r'$C_{\mathrm{LU}}$')
    elm.Capacitor().at((0, 0)).to((0, -2.2)).label(r'$C_{\mathrm{LS}}$', loc='bottom')
    elm.Capacitor().at((5, 0)).to((5, -2.2)).label(r'$C_{\mathrm{US}}$', loc='top')
    elm.Line().at((0, -2.2)).to((5, -2.2))
    elm.Dot().at((0, 0)).label('LOWER', loc='top', ofst=0.2)
    elm.Dot().at((5, 0)).label('UPPER', loc='top', ofst=0.2)
    elm.Dot().at((2.5, -2.2)).label('sky130_gnd', loc='bottom', ofst=0.2)
```
